correctness.rationale: Circular-gap support and perimeter identities are exact; alternating Taylor errors have controlled Dirichlet moments. Exponential influence polynomial has exact mean 0 and variance 360; the truncated exponential joint CLT gives independent Gumbel and Gaussian limits. Conditioning on the maximum yields a closed-form expectation and leading mixed covariance 2(log n)^4. Full normalization then gives pi^5/3. Finite quadrature checks only corroborate critical identities, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The max circular spacing controls Hausdorff error while the sum of cubic spacings controls the perimeter deficit. Their independent natural fluctuations conceal a strictly positive, quantitatively smaller mixed covariance; the new exact coefficient measures local/global shape-error coupling and supplies a natural benchmark for geometric sampling. The result is structural and not a routine finite recomputation.
